name: Banana Protein Pancakes
instructions: Mash bananas in a large bowl until smooth.
Add eggs, protein powder, oats, baking powder, and cinnamon. Mix well.
Heat coconut oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden. Serve warm.

substitutions.dairy_free: Protein powder is already dairy-free if using plant-based variety.
substitutions.low_carb: Replace oats with 2 tbsp almond flour and reduce banana to 1.
substitutions.vegan: Replace eggs with 2 flax eggs (2 tbsp ground flax + 6 tbsp water).

notes: Freeze extras between parchment paper for easy weekday breakfasts.
